notes.title: Bolide is Free to Play!
notes.content:
Start Your Journey Today for Free! Bolide has become free to play, so everyone can enjoy it! Choose from 40+ unique skills, 10 modes, 500+ customization options, and more, all for free!

Original owners of Bolide have had the ability to access exclusive deals prior to Bolide becoming free. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Bolide Version 2.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We've been playing Bolide for a while since launch, and we've come across a few bugs and issues that we wanted to fix. 

[list]
[*]The default modifiers button now properly saves the changed Double Skill Points and Respawns Available modifier if a game of Hardcore or Quick Play is played after clicking it
[*]The Play Challenge Waves setting is now set to off for new users
[*]The amount of shuffles available per game has increased from 2 to 5
[*]Made minor text improvements and other improvements
[/list]
Thanks for playing Bolide!

notes.title: Play Bolide With a Controller!
notes.content:
You can play Bolide with any controller, even though it doesn't feature native controller support!

To play with a controller, you can use Steam Input Translation. Steam Input Translation allows you to play games with a controller, by having the controls mimic the mouse and keyboard. In Bolide, you can use this feature to play with any controller of your choice!

First, you'll need to connect a controller to your computer. Then, enable Steam Input Translation by accessing your controller settings. We've found that the "Keyboard (WASD) and Mouse" layout is the best pre-made layout that works with Bolide. 

You can always change any controls to suit your desired playstyle by either editing your controller layout or editing the keybinds for an action (in Bolide's settings).

notes.title: Bolide Has Released!
notes.content:
I am proud to announce that I have released Bolide after more than 9 months of hard work! I've worked for hundreds of hours to ensure that Bolide is an enjoyable and content-filled game that would be fun for everyone. 

Creating Bolide was an amazing journey for me, and I hope you enjoy playing it!
